repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server maintains persistent state for MQTT QoS 2 delivery using JetStream.

### Problem Description

The server could store delivery state in response to MQTT acknowledgements that did not correspond to an outstanding QoS 2 delivery. A connected client could cause unnecessary persistent records to accumulate and exhaust storage available to its account, disrupting MQTT service for other users of that account.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.15.1. No fixed v2.14.x release was identified through v2.14.10. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-hm5m-vqj5-vf2q>
 * Credit: @SounLabs
repo.summary: Unexpected MQTT acknowledgements can consume JetStream storage
